// IntelliSense: Resolve C++ includes/flags from the includePath in c_cpp_properties.json (the header-only extension produces little in compile_commands); this is what makes Ctrl-click jump into the original ../cheatah library.
// C++ colorization: Semantic recoloring mis-paints identifiers in the concept/template-heavy headers (cheatah hit the same); let the TextMate C++ grammar be the sole source of truth so C++ highlights correctly.
// cheatah (.purr) highlighting: Map .purr to the `cheatah` language, provided by the cheatah VS Code extension (../cheatah/editors/vscode). Install it once: code --install-extension ../cheatah/editors/vscode/cheatah.vsix — it also gives Go-to-Definition from .purr into the cheatah libraries.
